subject: Pricing & renewal: Shoplytics expansion — blended-rate options & route add
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <amorgan@shoplytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 10:02:14 -0400
Subject: Follow-up: demo + renewal scope

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team was impressed with the latency profiles and the routing options you showed. A couple of follow-ups from our side as we scope the renewal:

- Current monthly usage: ~2.1M tokens (inference only) with spikes to ~3.6M on campaign days.
- Target expansion: evaluating a step-up to 10M tokens/month across three feature routes (search, summarization, personalization).
- Budget reality: procurement has given an initial target — they prefer $4k-$6k/month as the constrained range for year 1 of the expanded commitment.

Primary asks: can you provide a blended-rate view (per-1M tokens) for these volumes and call out options that materially lower unit cost (e.g., model quantization, routing to lower-cost variants, dedicated capacity vs hosted)? Also, we need a clear timeline for adding two extra routes (search & personalization) without disrupting current production traffic.

I can share our Q1 usage export if it helps. Procurement is cc'd (procurement@shoplytics.com) for timeline/PO questions.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of ML Product — Shoplytics
amorgan@shoplytics.com
[Attachment: shoplytics_usage_report_q1.csv (text/csv)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Alex Morgan <amorgan@shoplytics.com>, procurement@shoplytics.com
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 11:18:45 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo + renewal scope

Alex / Team,

Appreciate the clear asks — this is helpful. I pulled the usage file and sketched an initial cost sensitivity to share internally and with Shoplytics. Quick summary:

- Baseline: hosted API, current usage profile (2.1M/mo) maps to ~ $4.2k/month at your current per-token mix (we'll share the exact per-model breakout).
- Expansion scenario (10M/mo across 3 routes): pure hosted without discounts ranges from $15k-$22k/mo depending on model mix.
- Blended-rate levers that bring unit economics down: 1) 12M+/yr committed step-up (volume commit discount), 2) moving lower-latency but less costly requests to a smaller model or higher-quantization profile, 3) prefix/KV caching on summarization and personalization routes.

Attached: redwood_proposal_v1.pdf (blended band examples) and a sensitivity workbook I started. High-level options I recommend we present to Shoplytics:

1) Conservative step-up (12M tokens/year commitment) -> blended ~$8,500/month (equivalent ~ $708 / 1M tokens) with routing + caching enabled.
2) Aggressive commit (24M tokens/year) -> blended ~$5,000/month (equivalent ~ $208 / 1M tokens) but requires approval for a 12-24 month commit and adds dedicated capacity options to guarantee throughput.
3) Hybrid (hosted + route-add) -> prioritize keeping search on a smaller model variant and move personalization to a higher-quantized variant. Could land in the $4k-$7k/month band depending on willingness to accept some ROI tradeoffs on fidelity.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben: can you draft the blended-rate table with per-route assumptions (model, qtype, cache hit %)?
- Marissa: please own a one-pager mutual action plan with timeline (PO, trial/dev window, production cutover).
- Neha (me): I'll line up an internal sensitivity review and prepare a short deck for procurement.

Alex: a couple of clarifying Qs for your team so Ben/Marissa can finalize the numbers:
- Which routes need hard SLA (99th p95 latency) vs best-effort?
- Are you open to a 6-12 week dev window with limited test traffic for route tech validation?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_proposal_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 16:07:30 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo + renewal scope

All,

Putting some concrete numbers behind Neha's sketches. Attached is a quick sensitivity spreadsheet (pricing_model_sensitivity.xlsx) with the per-route assumptions. Key points to feed into the client conversation:

- Breakdown assumptions: search = smaller model (s1) at 0.8M tokens/day peak; summarization = midsize model (s3) with high KV cache potential (we assume 45% cache hit); personalization = midsize quantized (q4) optimized for cost.
- Blended proposals (monthly equivalents):
  * No commit: ~ $18k/mo (hosted, no discounts)
  * 12M/yr commit (12-mo contract): blended ~$8.1k/mo (~$675 / 1M tokens)
  * 24M/yr commit (24-mo contract + dedicated baseline): blended ~$4.7k/mo (~$196 / 1M tokens)

Notes on routing: we can execute route-level mix changes with zero downtime if we stage a traffic-splitting rollout over 2 weeks. For the immediate budget target Alex mentioned ($4k-$6k/mo), the closest path is the 24M annual commitment with strong caching and aggressive quantization on personalization. That does involve a small fidelity delta that we should quantify with Shoplytics.

Action items:
- I will iterate the sensitivity and produce a per-route table by EOD tomorrow.
- Marissa, I'll sync with you to draft the MAP that includes a 6-week tech validation + 2-week production ramp.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Alex Morgan <amorgan@shoplytics.com>

Cc: procurement@shoplytics.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:22:05 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo + renewal scope

Thanks Neha / Ben — this is really helpful and the scenarios map to the kinds of tradeoffs we expected. A few quick notes from procurement and product: 

- Procurement confirms the budget window: Shoplytics is targeting $4k-$6k/month for year 1 of the expanded scope. They are willing to consider a multi-year commit if the blended cost lands in the $3.5k-$5k/month range.
- Product: we are willing to accept up to a ~10% quality delta on personalization if it unlocks a 2x reduction in unit costs via quantization/caching.

Procurement also asked for a clear mutual action plan and dates so they can align on PO timing. Can you send a MAP with: milestone dates for dev validation, procurement review, legal/contract signature, and production cutover? Procurement contact: procurement@shoplytics.com.

If you can get the MAP and a version of the blended table that lands one realistic path in $3.5k-$5k/mo (with clear fidelity caveats), we can present to execs next week.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of ML Product — Shoplytics
amorgan@shoplytics.com
